exploit_multi/http/gitlab_cicd_regexp_rc.name: GitLab CI/CD RegExp Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution
author: joaxcar
Jonah Burgess
jheysel-r7
exploit_multi/http/gitlab_cicd_regexp_rc.description:
This module exploits an integer overflow in the Ruby regular expression compiler through
          GitLab's CI lint API. An attacker with credentials for a user who can push to a public
          project plants a crafted CI configuration and repository path. An unauthenticated CI
          lint request then compiles the expression and executes a command as the GitLab git account.

          The module selects the native pcode and libruby layout for affected official GitLab CE
          and EE Docker images on Linux amd64. Each attempt allocates slightly more than 2 GiB and crashes a
          Puma worker after execution. GitLab 19.2 before 19.2.8, 19.3 before 19.3.5, and 19.4
          before 19.4.2 are affected.

          The official 19.3.4 package already contains the Ruby overflow fix and is not supported.
          Rebuilt packages and source installations may require different native layouts.

auxiliary_admin/2wire/xslt_password_rese.name: 2Wire Cross-Site Request Forgery Password Reset Vulnerability
author: hkm <hkm@hakim.ws>
Travis Phillips
auxiliary_admin/2wire/xslt_password_rese.description:
This module will reset the admin password on a 2Wire wireless router.  This is
          done by using the /xslt page where authentication is not required, thus allowing
          configuration changes (such as resetting the password) as administrators.
